name: postez
description: Generate TypeScript interfaces and enums from PostgreSQL database schemas with custom type mappings

scripts.build: npm run build:clean && tsc && npm run build:cli && cp -R sql dist/ && chmod +x dist/cli.js
scripts.build:bun: bun run build:clean && tsc && bun run build:cli && cp -R sql dist/ && chmod +x dist/cli.js
scripts.build:cli:bun: bun build src/cli.ts --outfile dist/cli.js --target node --format cjs --external pg-promise --external prettier --external fs --external path --external os
scripts.test:node: which bun >/dev/null 2>&1 && bun test || echo 'Bun not found. Install Bun (https://bun.sh) to run tests, or use: bun test'
scripts.publish:patch: npm run build && npm version patch && npm publish
scripts.publish:minor: npm run build && npm version minor && npm publish
scripts.publish:major: npm run build && npm version major && npm publish

author: Daniel Ivanov
